Habitat V0.2 (Build 34 & 35)

Changelog

  • Improved: Spark menubar pop-out padding.
  • Spark energy now includes much more data and reporting.
  • Fixed: Window aware app quitter failing to quit sometimes.
  • Fixed: Occasional startup crash.

    • Habitat V0.2 (Build 33)

    Changelog

  • Improved: Language Localization. Added Italian!
  • Improved: Boa tool. Added file converter section and redesigned initial file upload in all sections.
  • Improved: Spark now has a charge limiter both in the battery tab and when hovering on the battery bar inside the menu bar icon.
  • Improved: Leap now has a dock preview to view all open windows of an app.
  • Improved: Echo now has cmd+x toggle to cut files in finder. Includes sound effect.
  • Improved: Shadow shelf now has option to select specific files you want to drag out instead of 1 at a time.
  • Fixed: Notch Nook spacing issues when music is playing with other modules enabled.
  • Fixed: Squeak gestures not working on mac dock if option to automatically hide dock is on.
  • Fixed: Spark Energy Impact graph not properly reporting correct usage sometimes.
  • Fixed: Chomp empty trash option sometimes not fully emptying.


    • More to come.

    — Thank you for all the support & feedback!
